Die Gegner wenden ein, dass die USA immer ein vielsprachiges Land gewesen sei. Sprachgesetze wären früher oft genutzt worden, um Immigranten aus Italien oder Osteuropa von Behördenjobs fernzuhalten.“

glosses: (in object-oriented programming) To create a subclass of (some class).

examples.text: I subclassed the Button class to create a more specialised FancyButton class for my user interface.

glosses: To cause (an object) to act as an instance of a subclass (by creating the desired subclass and instantiating an object of this subclass).

examples.text: Since Windows knows about these events, your application should be able to know about them as well. In order to accomplish this, subclass the window of a form or control, intercepting all of its events.
